stem: Which human geographic factor most likely prompted this observation?

options.label: F
options.text: The number of Quakers living in British colonies

options.label: G
options.text: The Caribbean slave trade with British colonies

options.label: H
options.text: The number of religious sects in the British colonies

options.label: J

visual_elements: As towns are established . . . along the rivers Savannah and Alatamaha, they will make such a barrier as will render the southern frontier of the British Colonies on the Continent of America, safe from Indian and other enemies. —General James Oglethorpe, 1733
